# List of countries by past and projected GDP (nominal) per capita

::: {#o1 .subject cue=lead name="List of countries by past and projected GDP (nominal) per capita"}

This is an alphabetical **list of countries by past and projected gross domestic product per capita**, based on official [exchange rates](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exchange_rate), not on the [purchasing power parity](wikipedia://en/64489) (PPP) methodology. Values are given in USDs and have not been adjusted for inflation. These figures have been taken from the [International Monetary Fund](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Monetary_Fund)'s World Economic Outlook (WEO) Database April 2026 edition),[^o2] [World Bank](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Bank), or various sources.

:::
